    • 字段详细资料

      • backupMode

        @NameInMap(value="BackupMode")
public String backupMode

        The type of the OSS backup migration task. Valid values:

        • FULL: restores data by using a full log file.
        • UPDF: restores incremental data by using differential or log log files.
        example:

        FULL

      • createTime

        @NameInMap(value="CreateTime")
public String createTime

        The time when the OSS backup migration task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

        example:

        2020-05-30T12:11:04Z

      • DBInstanceName

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceName")
public String DBInstanceName

        The instance ID.

        example:

        rm-uf6wjk5****

      • DBName

        @NameInMap(value="DBName")
public String DBName

        The name of the database.

        example:

        mytestdb

      • description

        @NameInMap(value="Description")
public String description

        The description of the OSS backup migration task.

        example:

        Success to DBCC checkdb asynchronously

      • endTime

        @NameInMap(value="EndTime")
public String endTime

        The time when the OSS backup migration task ended. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

        example:

        2021-05-30T15:15:05Z

      • isDBReplaced

        @NameInMap(value="IsDBReplaced")
public String isDBReplaced

        Specifies whether the import overwrites the existing database. Valid values:

        • False: no
        • True: yes
        example:

        False

      • migrateTaskId

        @NameInMap(value="MigrateTaskId")
public String migrateTaskId

        The ID of the OSS backup migration task.

        example:

        235943

      • requestId

        @NameInMap(value="RequestId")
public String requestId

        The ID of the request.

        example:

        6ED3635A-01F9-47BD-B9C8-CB3FD70A336E

      • status

        @NameInMap(value="Status")
public String status

        The status of the OSS backup migration task. Valid values:

        • NoStart: The task is not started.
        • Running: The task is running.
        • Success: The task is successful.
        • Failed: The task failed.
        • Waiting: The task is waiting for the import of incremental backup files.
        example:

        Success
